Klasse Util

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.util.Util
public final class Util extends Object

A small collection of general-purpose helper methods focused on input validation and defensive programming in a functional style.

This class only contains static methods and cannot be instantiated.

Seit:
1.0.0

  • Methodendetails

    • requireNonEmpty

      public static <C extends Collection<A>, A> C requireNonEmpty(@NonNull C collection, @NonNull String message)

      Ensures that the given collection is not empty.

      Returns the same collection instance if it is not empty; otherwise throws an IllegalArgumentException with the provided message.

      Typparameter:
      C - the concrete collection type
      A - the element type
      Parameter:
      collection - the collection to check; must not be null
      message - the error message if the collection is empty; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the same collection instance (for fluent usage)
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if collection or message is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if collection is empty
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • requireNonEmpty

      public static <C extends Collection<A>, A, E extends Exception> C requireNonEmpty(@NonNull C collection, @NonNull Supplier<E> exceptionSupplier) throws E

      Ensures that the given collection is not empty.

      Returns the same collection instance if it is not empty; otherwise throws the exception supplied by exceptionSupplier.

      Contract: exceptionSupplier.get() must not return null.

      Typparameter:
      C - the concrete collection type
      A - the element type
      E - the exception type to be thrown
      Parameter:
      collection - the collection to check; must not be null
      exceptionSupplier - supplies the exception to throw when the collection is empty; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the same collection instance (for fluent usage)
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if collection or exceptionSupplier is null, or if exceptionSupplier.get() returns null
      E - if collection is empty
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • requireNonNullElements

      public static <A, C extends Collection<A>, E extends Exception> C requireNonNullElements(@NonNull C collection, @NonNull String collectionName, @NonNull Fun<String,E> exceptionConstructor) throws E

      Ensures that all elements in the given Collection are non-null.

      If a null element is encountered, an exception created by exceptionConstructor is thrown. For List instances the message includes the index of the offending element; for other collections the container name is included without an index.

      Contract: exceptionConstructor.apply(message) must not return null.

      Typparameter:
      A - the element type
      C - the concrete collection type
      E - the exception type to be thrown
      Parameter:
      collection - the collection to check; must not be null
      collectionName - a descriptive name used in error messages; must not be null
      exceptionConstructor - builds the exception to throw; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the same collection instance (for fluent usage)
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if any argument is null or the constructor returns null
      E - if a null element is found
      Seit:
      1.0.0

      function - function to wrap; must not be null
      functionName - a descriptive name used in error messages; must not be null

    • isSubSet

      public static <A> boolean isSubSet(@NonNull Set<A> superSet, @NonNull Set<A> subSet)

      Checks whether subSet is a proper subset of superSet.

      A proper subset means every element of subSet is contained in superSet, and subSet is strictly smaller than superSet.

      Typparameter:
      A - element type
      Parameter:
      superSet - the superset; must not be null
      subSet - the subset candidate; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      true if subSet is a proper subset of superSet; otherwise false
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if superSet or subSet is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • mustBeConcrete

      public static <A, E extends RuntimeException> Class<A> mustBeConcrete(@NonNull Class<A> clazz, @NonNull Supplier<E> exceptionSupplier) throws E

      Ensures that the given class represents a concrete (instantiable) class.

      A concrete class is neither an interface nor abstract, nor a primitive or annotation type. Returns the same class object if it is concrete; otherwise throws the exception supplied by exceptionSupplier.

      Contract: exceptionSupplier.get() must not return null.

      Typparameter:
      A - class type
      E - exception type
      Parameter:
      clazz - class to check; must not be null
      exceptionSupplier - supplies the exception to throw if the check fails; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the same Class instance
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if clazz or exceptionSupplier is null, or if exceptionSupplier.get() returns null
      E - if clazz is an interface, primitive, annotation, or abstract
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • toSafeFileName

      public static String toSafeFileName(@NonNull String name)

      Converts a string into a safe file name.

      Replaces all whitespaces with underscores and removes all characters that are not alphanumeric, dots, hyphens, or underscores.

      Parameter:
      name - the original name; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a safe file name string
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if name is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0
